row.evidence: Squadcast's SSO guides cover SAML 2.0 with JIT creation ("Members trying to log into Squadcast through SSO who aren't already added to the Squadcast platform will be added to the platform by default as Users"); its support and API indexes document no SCIM endpoint.
row.notes: Squadcast is now SolarWinds Incident Response (squadcast.com redirects to solarwinds.com). No SCIM; JIT on SAML sign-in (merge may reclassify) plus an optional Entra ID user-removal sync via the Microsoft Teams bot. SSO is on all plans (compare table). Pro $15 and Premium $24 per user/month billed annually; Enterprise custom. REST API v3 on all plans can add, update, remove users and manage team roles; audit-log API maps to Enterprise 'Audit Logs'.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented. Users arrive by invite, CSV import, the REST API or JIT on SAML sign-in; Entra ID can also sync user removals.

endpoints.purpose: Add user with role (account_owner, user, stakeholder)
Delete user, reassigning entities to a swap user

user_api.notes: Squadcast API v3 (US https://api.squadcast.com, EU https://api.eu.squadcast.com). An API refresh token from the web app is exchanged at https://auth.squadcast.com/oauth/access-token for a bearer access token.

okta.notes: OIN app checks SAML only; its 'provisioning' is JIT creation on SAML sign-in with a role attribute.

entra.notes: Set up as a non-gallery SAML app; optional user-removal sync (needs the Microsoft Teams bot with admin permissions). Groups are not synced.

google.notes: Squadcast documents Google SSO; no Google catalogue page checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Entra ID user-removal sync (users removed in Azure AD are removed from Squadcast; needs the Microsoft Teams bot with admin permissions)

open_questions: Whether Entra user-removal sync also frees the seat or reassigns on-call entities is not documented.
Docs do not say whether API access needs a specific plan beyond 'Custom Integrations via API' on all plans, or publish rate limits.
